system.description:
ATTACK FOCUS SCREE TECHNIQUE

You do not chase an opening. You remain perfectly still until your opponent creates one.

Prerequisites Kamiri Heritage, Level 5

Action R; Trigger a creature within reach of your Raptorial Blade misses you with a melee Strike that you are aware of

You immediately make a Raptorial Blade Strike against the triggering creature. Apply your multiple attack penalty normally if one applies.

Automated: when a creature misses you with a melee Strike (a reaction Strike included) and you have a Raptorial Blade, you are asked whether to use it: your reaction and its Focus use, and a Raptorial Blade Strike against it. It is a reaction, so the system applies no multiple attack penalty to it (audit interpretation 7). Being within the blade's reach is yours to confirm.
